title: ∴⍑ᔑℸ (What Meme Thaumometer)
description: Replaces the scan sound with 5 notes of the Earthbound Sanctuary Guardian theme, and adds Standard Galactic Alphabet text saying "what" in the lens
body:
# What this does
Adds Standard Galactic Alphabet text saying "what" to the lens, and 5 notes from the Earthbound Soundtrack's "Sanctuary Guardian" song.
## Why
- Funni do do do do doo jingle
- A friend of mine asked me to make it
